p1.title: 換日清序列與 append 條件不對稱 — 非今日 trade_date 會抹掉當日序列(記憶體+磁碟,有 repro)
p1.disposition: accepted → fix(紅先行):清序列僅 new==today;new≠today 且 old 非 None 時不採用日期變更(warning)

p1.title: as_of/分鐘鍵取自未過濾全快照 max(date),單一髒 row 讓序列塌成一格(有 repro)
p1.disposition: accepted → fix(紅先行):max_tick_datetime 加 upper_bound(now+10min),越界 row 忽略

p1.title: maps 24h TTL 用單調鐘不隨交易日換 — 跨日沿用前一日處置名單
p1.disposition: accepted → fix(紅先行):TTL 之外加 day != today 失效條件(兩張 map 同修);log 文案「空集合續行」改為實況「保前值」

p1.title: prod DEFAULT_BREADTH 接線零覆蓋(mutation:三元組調序全綠)
p1.disposition: accepted → lock test:token 閘兩態 + fetcher 身分比對釘順序

p1.title: restore 形狀防禦零覆蓋(mutation:_is_bucket_row 恆 True 全綠);畸形點會流到前端成 NaN
p1.disposition: accepted → lock test:畸形 point 參數化(部分丟棄)+ _save OSError 降級測試

p2_behavior.disposition: accepted → fix:boot 未完成時 REST 回載入中語意(enabled=true, counts=null),不回「未設定」
accepted → fix(紅先行):退避指數 min 夾制,防 streak>=1024 OverflowError 殺 poll task
accepted → fix(紅先行,前端):refetch 全量與 WS 增量競態 — refetch 套 union-by-t 合併
accepted → fix:maps 取數失敗加退避(quota 沿 quota_backoff_secs),不以 10s 重打最重 endpoint
accepted → fix(前端):BreadthBand 顯示 trade_date,開盤前舊曲線可辨識
accepted → test-infra fix:loop 存活傘罩測試注入點移到 _fetch_snapshot 管不到的路徑
accepted → lock test:WS route 層第二則(增量含 last_minute)
accepted → parity 測試加 max_tick_datetime 真值兩行斷言
accepted → lock test:verify fake 三元組語意 + VERIFY_BREADTH_FAIL 注入
accepted → 改鏡像測試為硬編值(或刪)
accepted → fix:verify fake stamp 域外時 clamp 進 0901-1330,盤後 verify 序列可目視
accepted → design 字面收斂為「保前值」+ 補「先成功後失敗保前值」測試
